mapper.insert: insert into topic_completion_xp_award (member_id, topic_id, xp_amount, granted_at, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{topicId}, #{xpAmount}, #{grantedAt}, now())
mapper.select: select xp_amount as earnedXp, granted_at as earnedXpAt from topic_completion_xp_award where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId} limit 1
select xp_amount from topic_completion_xp_award where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId} limit 1 for update
mapper.delete: delete from topic_completion_xp_award where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId}
